result.title: Best-of-Depth: Learning Exploratory Dynamics in Looped Transformers
result.summary: Looped Transformers extend inference-time computation through repeated latent-state updates, but final-depth training does not directly encourage useful intermediate alternatives. We introduce Best-of-Depth (BoD), which trains a recurrent trajectory as a candidate set by minimizing prediction loss across depths. Different valid targets can be matched at different depths without architectural changes or depth-specific labels. An exact-match analysis connects this objective to solution coverage. On N-Queens completion and graph coloring, BoD improves coverage over final-depth and intermediate-supervision objectives. N-Queens coverage reaches 91.03%, versus 45.75% for final-depth training. Further experiments show discovery beyond the training depth and recovery of solutions withheld from teacher pools on familiar inputs. Fine-tuning a pretrained looped language model with BoD yields higher pooled code-generation success than final-depth training when programs are generated separately at evaluated fixed depths. These results support training recurrent computation for solution discovery along its trajectory.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Best-of-Depth，把循环 Transformer 的递归轨迹视为候选集，在各深度上最小化预测损失以训练中间状态，并在 N-Queens、图着色和代码生成上评估解覆盖与超出训练深度的发现能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽非视觉工作，但其按深度监督循环 latent 状态、以轨迹覆盖解并检验深度外泛化的做法，可能为 LVR 的循环计算训练、候选状态筛选与 STOP/深度选择提供可核查线索。
